integrity: The conditional law is derived by applying the classical forest-extension formula to a fixed geodesic and then to that geodesic augmented by prescribed endpoint edges. The stochastic order is realized by an explicit coupling. Exact Prüfer-code enumeration independently replays the finite distributions through n=8.
scientific_limitations: The model is the uniform labeled tree on a fixed vertex set.
The stochastic regression is from marked-vertex distance to one endpoint degree; no reverse conditional monotonicity is claimed.
The forest-extension count is classical, and older enumerative tree literature may contain an equivalent bivariate specialization.
title: Exact negative regression between endpoint degree and distance in a uniform Cayley tree
